author: Jopi679

title: Really good
body: I really enjoy tracking my goals for the day with HabitMinder, it’s really simple. One detail is that I really would like to have the option to see my goals in a more compressed format. FontSize looks too big and space between each goal is huge and sometimes I would like to see at a glance the goals for the day or the onces that are not yet completed instead of having to swipe down to see other goals. If that could be added, would be 5 star for sure. Thanks!
author: totofrechou

title: Suggestions
body: There should be an option to personalize colours, I don’t like the strong colors that much and would rather like to use pastel colors. Also habit icons should be easier to find, perhaps they could be organized into categories. Other than that the app is great
